title: fix(components,plugin-list,plugin-detail): the page root reads its nested aria bag, and ListView and useRecordAriaProps map through the shared reader (objectui#11083)
body:
Part of #11083
Clause-②: no

The page root now renders the `aria` bag the spec declares on it, and the two blocks that kept their own mapping of that bag (`ListView`'s list region, `plugin-detail`'s `useRecordAriaProps`) now go through `resolveInlineAriaProps`, the shared reader PR objectui#11078 added to `@object-ui/react`. There is no second mapping table.

**Why `Part of` and not the order's `Fixes`.** One sub-item needs a decision and is reported on the card, not done here: whether `ListView` stops reading `aria.live`. The measurements are in the section on it below. This PR keeps that read exactly as it was. The card's other items are all in this PR.

## What changed

1. **Page root (the defect).** `PageRenderer` gives its wrapper `toDomProps(props)`, which keeps only DOM attributes, so the `aria` object was dropped and `{ type: 'page', aria: { ariaLabel: 'Page name' } }` rendered no `aria-label` anywhere. The wrapper (the element carrying `data-page-type`) now also spreads `resolveInlineAriaProps(schema.aria, useDisplayLocale())`. It is spread after `pageProps`, so when a flat key and the nested bag name the same attribute, the page's own declared slot wins. The page adds no default role, and a page with no `aria` renders the same DOM as before.
2. **ListView (consolidation).** The inline mapping (label, described-by, role) is replaced by `const regionAria = resolveInlineAriaProps(schema.aria, displayLocale)`, spread on the region, plus `role={regionAria.role ?? 'region'}` as ListView's default. Measured: the label had **no** non-aria fallback. It came only from `schema.aria.ariaLabel`, so there was nothing else to keep. One visible difference: an authored `role: ''` used to render an empty `role` attribute, and now falls back to `region` (pinned). The `aria.live` read is kept unchanged (see below).
3. **`useRecordAriaProps` (consolidation).** Built on the shared reader and the display locale. It keeps its signature, the caller's `defaultRole` and `defaultLabel`, the `region` fallback, and the refused-`aria.label` report. The report stays in an effect keyed on the message. The internal `useRecordAriaName` (one caller, never exported from the package) became a report-only hook, so this module no longer resolves the label itself.
4. **Docs.** `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md`, the PageSchema table, gains an `aria` row (AGENTS.md #2). This file is outside the claim's declared surface, and the report says so.

## `aria.live`: measured, the read is kept, and a decision is needed

Triage direction 2: "Measure whether any document authors it first. None ⇒ the read goes (objectui#2890's residue). Some ⇒ stop and report it on this card."

**Census.** The pattern is the value form `live` followed by `polite`, `assertive` or `off` (any quoting), which also catches a multi-line bag.
- objectui at base `3e71a9825`: 5 hits in 4 files, **all test fixtures**: `normalize-list-view.test.ts`, `ListView.test.tsx`, `inlineAria.test.ts` and `p1-spec-alignment.test.ts`.
- objectstack at `origin/main` `cd901d7a`: 2 hits, both in `packages/spec/src/ui/i18n.test.ts`.
- There are **0** in examples, apps, seeds or docs.
- The lit control is the value form of `ariaDescribedBy` over the same trees: 18 lines in objectui and 6 in objectstack.

So no document authors it. But the premise that it is "residue" does not hold, because `live` is a **declared** key with a named producer of guidance:
- objectui declares it. The zod mirror's `ListViewSchema.aria` is `stripImportedDefaults(SpecAriaPropsSchema).extend({ live })`, described as "objectui-only — promote rather than grow this extension". The `NamedListView.aria` interface also carries `live`. objectui#2890's changeset kept it on purpose: "`aria.live` stays as a documented local extension — it has no spec counterpart, and dropping it would silently disable a shipped capability."
- The **published** spec, `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0 as installed here, refuses `live` on every other surface with this guidance: "On an objectui list view the key is valid as-is; anywhere else, drop it." The spec pins that text in `i18n.test.ts`, together with a reconstruction of objectui's `.extend({ live })` that accepts it.
- objectstack#5058, the promotion question, was closed `not_planned` on 2026-09-24 on the maintainer's word. Its rationale names "objectui's own extension carries the rendering".

Dropping only the read would leave `live` accepted by objectui's own schema and recommended by the spec's refusal text, then silently dropped at render. That is declared ≠ enforced, the trap this card exists to remove. Retiring it properly also moves a type (`@object-ui/types`, so Clause-② becomes yes) and changes the spec's published guidance text in the other repo. So this PR stops on that half and reports it on the card, with options.

## Tests

The runs are from the worktree root with root-relative paths. They were measured at `904eed298`. `git diff --stat 904eed298 f4969f552 -- packages/` is empty, so the `packages/` tree is byte-identical to head `f4969f552` (the later commits add the changeset and the docs row).

- New pins:
  - `page-root-aria-11083.test.tsx`: real `SchemaRenderer` and registry, under `I18nProvider`. A plain string under en and zh, a locale map under en and zh, described-by and role, no bag adds nothing, and a flat-`ariaLabel` control. 7 tests.
  - `ListView.nestedAriaSharedReader-11083.test.tsx`: described-by, an authored role, the region default, an empty role falling back to region, a zh locale map, and `live` kept. 6 tests.
  - `recordAriaSharedReader-11083.test.tsx`: a plain string and a locale map under zh, a locale map under en, and `record:path`'s default role carrying a zh name. 4 tests.
- Targeted run, new pins plus the existing aria pins (`ListView.ariaLabelInlineLocale`, `recordComponentAria-9556`, `recordAriaLabelRetired-9945`, `record-quick-actions.ariaLabel`): `Test Files 7 passed (7)`, `Tests 82 passed (82)`.
- Wider run: `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/`, every `page-*` / `react-page-*` / `html-page-lazy-blocks` / `guide-layout-page-buttons` / `page*ItemMembers` test in `packages/components/src/__tests__/`, `ListView.test.tsx`, `i18nLabel-resolver-parity.test.ts`, and all of `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/`. Result: `Test Files 107 passed (107)`, `Tests 1247 passed (1247)`.
- Type-check, after building the dependency closure (`--filter` with the `^...` suffix on the three packages, 13 packages): `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check`, `@object-ui/plugin-list` and `@object-ui/plugin-detail`. Each exited 0, and each ran `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`. Each package's `tsconfig.test.json` includes `src/**/*.test.tsx`, so the new pins are type-checked.
- **Ablation (page root).** This used `ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode on the committed fix. It deleted the `{...pageAria}` spread (anchor 1 → 0, blob `f5185737dbf2` → `b05ab1b57c9e`) and ran the page pin. The predicted direction was 5 red and 2 green (the no-bag case and the flat control). Measured: `Tests 5 failed | 2 passed (7)`, exactly those five. After the restore, the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The same file on the restored tree: 7 passed.

## Gates

- eslint on the 6 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files: exit 0, and the JSON output lists 6 files with 0 errors. The warnings are all on lines this diff does not touch. The linted population comes from eslint's own config (`files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}']`). The config has no `parserOptions.project` and no `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot move the verdict on an untouched file. `pnpm lint` over the whole repo belongs to CI.
- Exit 0 on the tree at head `f4969f552`:
  - `check-changeset-presence`, `check-control-bytes`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations`;
  - `check-changeset-claims`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-pending-changeset-literals`;
  - `check-phantom-dependencies`, `check-unused-dependencies`;
  - `check-handler-key-read-sites`, `check-unreferenced-sources`, `check-test-path-roots`;
  - `check-doc-component-types`, `check-doc-fence-languages`, `check-doc-links`, `check-doc-example-ids`.
- Self-scan for control bytes over the changed files: no hits.

## Acceptance notes

These are out of scope and noted only, not filed.
- **The page root has no default role.** An authored `aria.ariaLabel` with no `aria.role` lands on the wrapper `div`, which is `generic`, and browsers expose no name on it. This is the same question triage kept off this card for `element:text` / `element:number` (its own card, once there is an assistive-technology measurement). The page follows that ruling and adds no default. Carrier: that future card. No other carrier.
- **A pending changeset quotes the old ListView source.** `.changeset/9556-record-component-aria-honoured.md` quotes ListView's old `role=` expression for the region's precedence. The precedence (the authored role, else `region`) still holds, but the quoted expression is no longer literal source. This PR does not edit another PR's pending changeset. Carrier: none.
